# V2.0.0-beta - Radian

This is a **pre-release for beta testers**. Install it only if you agreed to test it. It is not offered to installed stable copies through the in-app update check; the stable release remains 1.1.1 until 2.0.0 is final.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Back up `~/.pi` before you install a beta over an existing installation. To leave the beta, uninstall it and install the stable release again.

## What is new in 2.0

- **Pi SDK 1.0.** The application now runs on the Pi 1.0 packages.
- **Node host and web client.** Fate UI can run as a plain Node server with a browser client, and the desktop application can connect to such a host. The network terminal is off unless the host turns it on, and a network client starts read-only.
- **Native durable storage (opt-in).** The default storage is unchanged (`legacy-json`). `native-durable` must be selected explicitly and has its own migration and review commands; see `docs/v2/`.
- **Agents in isolated workspaces.** A sub-agent that already works in an isolated worktree now keeps its own sub-agents in that worktree unless it asks for another workspace.

## Fixed during beta preparation

- Installers were missing runtime libraries of the model providers.
- The two standard Pi themes were missing on a profile without its own Pi themes.
- The application could fail to quit on macOS: quitting started the global keyboard hook. The hook now starts only for push-to-talk, in a helper process, so it cannot freeze the application.
- After a crash, a forced quit or a power loss the next start was refused. The application now recovers a lock whose owner process no longer exists.
- The music player reported a missing yt-dlp when the bundled one started slowly.
- The browser terminal lost its connection and its control when a shell ended.

## Please test and report

- Starting again after a forced quit or a crash.
- Push-to-talk (Settings, voice hotkey in push-to-talk mode), especially on macOS and Linux: no automated check can press a global hotkey.
- Agent Teams with isolated worktrees and nested sub-agents.
- Connecting the desktop application or a browser to a Node host.

## Known limits

- On Windows and macOS a lock left by a crash stays while another program holds the old process number; it is recovered once that program ends.
- Lock recovery needs a filesystem with hard links.
- `--new-instance` still shares one profile owner: a second instance on the same profile is refused.
- Installers remain unsigned, and macOS builds are not notarized. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS`.

## Install and trust

The artifact set is Windows x64 EXE; macOS Apple Silicon and Intel DMG and PKG; Linux x64 AppImage and DEB; plus `SHA256SUMS`. Publishing is gated on the four-runner package, install and smoke matrix and an exact seven-installer checksum set.
